purpose: Teach: 大木/所沢/野原/大輔/中西/大津/大平/大江

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが庭の大木の剪定をして下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's going to trim that big tree in the garden.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gentle opening. Pacing is unhurried — she's sharing news that delights her about what his father is doing for the family. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと埼玉県所沢の航空公園に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to the aviation museum in Tokorozawa with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, unselfconscious joy. Quick tempo. He's eager to share this experience. Slight lift at the end — looking for her to receive it. The openness of a child who trusts he'll be listened to.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「野原のお父様、つまりお祖父様にもよろしく」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said to give his regards to Grandfather, too.
lines.style: Gentle, conversational. A slight pause before 'Grandfather' — she's translating his words with care. Tone is warm and reflective, like she's relaying something that matters. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのお友達の大輔おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Uncle Daisuke — Dad's friend.
lines.style: Eager, proud that he's met someone new. Quick energy. The slight breathlessness of wanting to tell her everything at once. Open posture in the voice — he trusts her interest.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが中西さんと旧友のお話を楽しまれたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father really enjoyed catching up with Mr. Nakanishi — an old friend.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation in her voice. Observant tone — she's noticing and reflecting on what makes her husband happy. Warm but composed. Slight wistfulness, like she's seeing him through the lens of good company.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと滋賀県大津の琵琶湖に行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to Lake Biwa in Otsu with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, straightforward pleasure. Light, unforced delivery. He's simply reporting joy. No performance — just clean, direct happiness. Slight pause before 'Lake Biwa' as if the place itself is vivid to him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは「大平の世が続けばいい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said he hopes peaceful days like these continue on.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine reflection. She's offering his words with tenderness — there's weight under the gentleness. Slow, measured pacing. Trailing softly, as if this is something she's turning over in her own mind too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと大江健三郎の絵本を読んだよ
lines.en: Mom, I read a picture book with Dad — one by Kenzaburo Oe.
lines.style: Warm contentment. Relaxed tempo. He's settling into the memory of sharing this quiet moment. Soft, satisfied tone — like the feeling of being held while listening to a story. Small voice, full trust.
